articles.title: CBSE result scheme for Class 10th students in Middle East: How scorecards will be prepared
articles.summary: CBSE has launched a special assessment scheme for Class 10 students in the Middle East, replacing the cancelled remaining board exams. This decision, aimed at ensuring academic continuity amidst global disruptions, significantly impacts Indian students abroad. It reflects CBSE's adaptive approach to evaluating student performance without traditional examinations, a key development in national education policy for aspirants to be aware of.

articles.title: Watch viral video: India sends more warships to Strait of Hormuz to ensure safe passage of ships amid Iran–Israel tensions
articles.summary: India has deployed additional warships to the Gulf of Oman and Arabian Sea, bolstering maritime security to safeguard its commercial vessels. This proactive measure responds to ongoing tensions disrupting movement through the critical Strait of Hormuz. The deployment underscores India's commitment to protecting its economic interests and ensuring safe passage for its trade in a volatile international shipping lane.

articles.title: Saudi FM warns Iran that patience in Gulf not ‘unlimited’ amid attacks
articles.summary: Saudi Arabia's Foreign Minister Prince Faisal bin Farhan Al Saud has issued a stern warning to Iran, stating that Riyadh's tolerance for attacks on the Kingdom and neighboring Gulf states is limited. He urged Tehran to immediately cease these actions, highlighting growing regional tensions. This emphasizes the need for diplomatic resolution and maintaining peace in the Middle East.
